description: Submits a project homepage to RoboDebut's directory for manual operator review. Intended for submissions the user has authorized, after the required visible followed RoboDebut badge is deployed on that homepage. Runs a bounded check of the public homepage HTML for the badge. A badge does not prove ownership. A submission check can also lead to a site icon fetch, a third-party domain rating lookup and a private operator notice. Requires the user's contact email. Creates a new unapproved submission, or rechecks an eligible earlier submission for the same domain after a failed homepage check or an expired check reservation and updates its stored check result. Never edits submitted details, approves or publishes a listing. A domain already awaiting review returns pending_review unchanged, and rejected domains are not accepted.

contact_email.description: A contact address supplied by the user for this listing. It is used for operator review, private Telegram notices when configured, badge reminders and approval email. RoboDebut excludes it from public listings, submission and status responses, server logs and analytics. The calling MCP client also handles this input.

homepage_url.description: Public HTTPS apex or www homepage, without credentials or a custom port. Shared service validation normalizes to the root and registrable domain.

name: submit_project

already_in_review.description: Present only when the website was already awaiting review before this request. This request created no submission, saved none of its details and has no status_receipt.

status_receipt.description: Secret receipt issued only to the request creating this submission; duplicates and retries receive none. Anyone holding it can read this submission's status.
